prepSteps.title: Create a Jenkins API user
prepSteps.instruction: On the Jenkins controller, create a user with read access to jobs and credentials metadata, generate an API token, and confirm the Connector can reach the controller URL.
prepSteps.evidence: Jenkins shows the Entro user and the Connector loads the login page

typedActions.preview: java -jar jenkins-cli.jar -s "$JENKINS_URL" list-users or who-am-i inspect
typedActions.mutation: Create a Jenkins user with read access to jobs and credentials metadata and generate an API token (operator copies token in Jenkins UI or CLI groovy); confirm Connector reachability
typedActions.expectedChange: Jenkins shows the Entro user and the Connector loads the login page
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Delete the Jenkins user created this run; token revoke in the user configure page
